name: ai-raccoon
description: Agent memory server: semantic search, durable-fact writes, workspaces, promotion to a shared tier, and directory watching, served over MCP stdio by default; `ai-raccoon serve` launches the HTTP mode on 127.0.0.1:7721/mcp with a 4h idle watchdog. The catalog declares it scope:user, so the operator registers it once in a user-global config instead of every project declaring it.
